verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own rule-driven automation. Admins set spend rules and limits that are auto-enforced, including automatically blocking out-of-policy purchases. Multi-level approval flows route automatically based on amount, vendor and role, and AI agents auto-approve or escalate expenses according to policy. However, this is limited to preset spend and approval domains, not a general event-to-action rule builder, and the evidence is marketing-level only (webhooks and Zapier/Workato recipes are external building blocks and earn no credit). Missing for 10: a general-purpose configurable event-trigger/action rule engine, detailed docs on rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
